## Checklist

- [ ] Rule changes cite the standard and add a passing and a failing test case
- [ ] `run_checks.py` passes; render tests run when output or layout logic changed

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md`, `references/coverage.md` and docs updated when behaviour changed
